step-01.title: DISCOVERY
step-01.description: We audit your current systems, analyze requirements, and map the technical landscape. Every project begins with understanding the problem space completely.

step-02.description: We design the system blueprint — database schemas, API contracts, infrastructure topology. Nothing is built until the foundation is mathematically sound.

step-03.description: Sprint-based development with weekly deployments. You see progress in real-time. Every commit is tested, every deployment is automated.

step-04.description: Production launch with monitoring, alerting, and documentation. We don't disappear after launch — we ensure the system is battle-tested.
